success.text: Thanks for your order, your purchase is now complete. You will receive an email confirmation shortly.

error.text: Unfortunately, we were unable to find your order. Please click the button below to return to your account.

failed.text: We were unable to process your payment for this order, this could be for a number of reasons.
failed.textRetry: Please click below to go to your invoice where you can retry your payment.

invalid.text: We're unable to retrieve your past order as your session has expired. To start a new purchase, please click the button below to return to our store.
